notes.title: Fix bug on the 2nd floor in a scene with a blue-haired girl.
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with animation on the 2nd floor with a blue-haired girl. Thank you [b]MrLimurchik[/b] for the tip!
Saving the game after fixing the error may not work correctly - you will need to start the game again. Thank you all for your feedback.

notes.title: bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a crash on the 3rd floor after the Minotaur. Fixed the display of images of anal sex on the 1st floor. Saving the game after the bug fix will not work - the game will need to start over. Thank you all for your feedback.
